correctness.rationale: For GQ(2,2), a complete case split shows that fewer than four sources fail even porous exponential domination; four on one shore are excluded by the (15,6,1,3) point-graph common-neighbor identity; 3+1 fails on eight skew lines; and 2+2 forces two disjoint duads plus their two crossing synthemes, hence 45 flags. Exact blocked-source BFS values 16 at 9/8, 8 at 21/16 and 2 at 3 prove sufficiency. Two independently constructed incidence models exhaust all 27,405 size-four candidates and verify that 45 flags comprise the complete answer. Shared-source incidence proves no two optimizers overlap in more than one vertex, a direct count yields degree 20, and BFS of the full 45-optimum graph establishes diameter 2. No infinite-family claim is made.

originality.rationale: Comparison is by mathematical implication. The foundational exponential-domination sources define porous and blocked-distance nonporous domination and obtain bounds but do not give the exact 45 minimum configurations in the Tutte–Coxeter cage. The classical duad-syntheme/flag model is credited, rather than claimed as new. Other cage invariants and graph reconfiguration results use different success conditions. No checked source supplies an equivalent full optimizer classification or a stronger statement forcing the three-source exchange threshold; an unindexed finite census remains a priority uncertainty.
residual_risks: A pre-existing but unindexed exhaustive computation of exponential domination on this small named graph could duplicate the value or optimizer family.
Related literature inaccessible beyond summaries may contain an implicit equality-case result; no decisive unresolved covering implication was found in accessible primary texts.

The exact exchange graph is certified by finite exhaustive computation; the 20-regular degree has a direct proof, but the diameter-two step is algorithmic rather than a separate symbolic classification.

value.rationale: On the canonical 30-vertex cubic girth-eight cage, exact blocked-distance domination has natural object-level motivation from the foundational subcubic exponential-domination framework. The strict-margin 45-flag optimizer classification recovers the geometry from a different graph invariant, while a sharp replacement threshold of three separates frozen one/two-source local mobility from a connected diameter-two optimum landscape. The exact full classification is natural, nontrivial and reusable as a graph-coverage/reconfiguration benchmark; neither a routine general bound nor a recomputation of an identified table.
